RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Unknown; these facts do not support a defensible 0–100 estimate.

An all-male panel raises a legitimate question about representation and safeguards against bias, but does not establish that sex influenced this decision. Your qualifications appear strong; the announcement alone doesn’t establish the appointee’s full experience or how candidates met the selection criteria.

Follow up now requesting the criteria, weightings, feedback on your assessment, and applicable recruitment and panel-composition policies. You can neutrally ask how the panel ensured fair, consistent assessment, including safeguards against sex bias.

Two weeks’ silence is worth pursuing, not proof of discrimination. If explanations reveal inconsistent standards or procedural breaches, consider a formal challenge. Check local complaint deadlines promptly; awaiting feedback may not pause them.
